contact.basis: Unmasked original elevation by the mapped visitor center approach, west of the bare-rock opening.

verticalDatum: USGS 3DEP source elevations in meters. Site-relative model origin at the signed visitor approach sample.
attribution: U.S. Geological Survey 3DEP, The National Map
method: Unchanged federal elevation raster sampled at the recorded GeoTIFF pixel centers. Original field kept for inspection; native-resolution values separately drive the authored geological surfaces.
limitations: Raster height samples convey uppermost surfaces. Overhangs, fractures and individual boulders require photo-guided approximation.
The Earth viewer may sample a coarser terrain provider. The cutout is limited to the mapped bare-rock perimeter.
